summary.name: Perian
summary.one_liner: Perian is a free, open source QuickTime component that adds playback of many non-native formats such as AVI, DivX, FLV and MKV on Mac, and is being retired by its developers.
use_cases: play MKV or AVI files in QuickTime Player on a Mac
play DivX, XviD or FLV video on older macOS
add subtitle support (SSA/ASS, SRT, SAMI) to QuickTime
find legacy Mac video playback options
summary.what_it_does: Perian is a QuickTime component for Mac OS X that lets QuickTime-based apps play many formats it does not support natively, including AVI, DivX, FLV, MKV, VP6/VP8, HuffYUV, MPEG-1/2, and various audio codecs such as AC3, AAC, Vorbis and DTS. It also adds subtitle support for SSA/ASS, SRT and SAMI. It works with QuickTime Player, NicePlayer and QTAmateur. The page notes that MKV files take a while to load because Perian must read the entire file for seeking and playback. Per the page, it does not open the MPEG container format itself, only MPEG audio and video codecs. The page also includes uninstall instructions and a list of obsolete QuickTime components to remove.
notable: Open source QuickTime component with a long list of supported codecs and subtitle formats
Works with QuickTime Player, NicePlayer and QTAmateur
Developers are retiring the project; source to be posted on Google Code or GitHub
caveats: No longer actively developed; support ends 90 days after the final release
May or may not work on macOS 10.8
Cannot open MPEG container files due to QuickTime limitations
No iPhone version; iPhone lacks QuickTime
MKV files load slowly because the whole file must be read
